race.comment: GRANDSTANDER (14) gets the nod despite a plain looking form line. Should find this a bit easier dropping back from mid-week company at Doomben where he was doing his best work late. Draws to get back again but gets help at the weights with the claimer on and can launch late if the pace is genuine. MAHMOA (3) kicked off the prep with an encouraging effort but has since struggled. Could give one more chance. QUARTZOPOLIS (7) has been safely held this campaign, yet the drop from Eagle Farm mid-week company and fourth-up fitness give him scope to rebound if the shorter trip sharpens him. Worth noting the application of blinkers firs time too. MOONLIGHT ODYSSEY (4) has done well to hit the frame in both runs back and should only be further improved. Can play a role.
